question: What extension of the right fist's index finger forms the bāṇa mudrā?
premises: The right hand forms a fist.
This configuration is the bāṇa mudrikā.
inference: Extending the index finger of the right fist forms the bāṇa mudrā.
plain_english: With the index finger of the right fist extended, this is the bāṇa mudrā.
